messages:
Amira (support): FYI — Customer ACME just opened an escalation (ticket #3821). They say chat responses abruptly became very terse and factual after this morning's platform defaults change. They claim no changes on their side.

Amira (support): Customer example: previously prompt returned ~6-8 sentences. Now responses are 1-2 short lines and refuse to elaborate. They attached request/response. Asking for an urgent rollback or workaround. :rotating_light:

Amira (support): Copy of their request payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-redwood",
  "prompt": "Explain the onboarding flow for a new user.",
  "temperature": 0.0,
  "top_p": 0.0,
  "max_tokens": 300
}
```

Jon (ml): Hmm that looks like sampling was effectively disabled. Did we push a change to sampling defaults this morning? I remember a PR to make defaults deterministic for evals.

Laura (eng-runtime): We had a config push at 07:12 UTC to the hosted-defaults SSM path: `defaults/sampling` — changed `temperature: 0.7 -> 0.0` and `top_p: 0.95 -> 0.0` for a short QA experiment. It should have been gated but the gate flag didn't flip. deploy-bot: `rollout/hosted-defaults v20240612.3 completed`.

Max (prod): Oof. That would explain ecosystem-wide terse outputs. Need a mitigation plan: can we patch tenant overrides so paying customers keep previous defaults?

Jon (ml): Short repro: call the same prompt with explicit sampling params set to 0.8/0.95 and compare. If that restores behavior, it's definitely the defaults.

Amira (support): I ran that for ACME with their exact prompt and explicit params — they get long, explanatory output again. I pasted both snippets in ticket. Customer is on a call in 20m.

Laura (eng-runtime): Rolling a rollback now to restore hosted-defaults to `temperature: 0.7` / `top_p: 0.95`. Will flip the gate and restart config watchers. ETA ~5-10m. I will also add a tenant override route for ACME until we have a proper rollout process.

Amira (support): Please DM me when done so I can update the customer.

deploy-bot: Rollout event: `rollback/hosted-defaults v20240612.3 -> v20240612.2` initiated by Laura. Status: in-progress.

Jon (ml): After rollback we should run a quick A/B test across a sample of stored prompts to ensure we don't regress other customers. Also add a one-line note in the deploy changelog: "Do not flip sampling defaults without gated canary".

Max (prod): I'm also opening a P0 postmortem stub. We need to tighten rollout gating for platform-wide defaults.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed. `rollback/hosted-defaults v20240612.3 -> v20240612.2` status: success.

Laura (eng-runtime): Confirmed. Gate reset, watchers restarted. Tenant override for ACME created: `tenant/overrides/acme -> {temperature:0.7, top_p:0.95}`.

Amira (support): Update to customer: "We identified a mistaken defaults push that made sampling deterministic (temperature/top_p set to 0). We've rolled it back and applied a tenant override. You should see behavior restored now. We're monitoring — please flag if anything still looks off."

Amira (support): Customer replied: "Looks back to normal, thanks — would like a short postmortem."

Jon (ml): Action items: 1) Postmortem draft, 2) Add automated check in deploy pipeline to block sampling-defaults changes without canary, 3) Add dashboard alert when global sampling params change.

Max (prod): On it — I'll assign owners in the postmortem.

Amira (support): Closing the customer escalation as resolved, leaving ticket open for postmortem. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
